DROP TABLE [DW].[DimAccount]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [DW].[DimAccount]
( 
	[AccountSK] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[AccountID] [varchar](34)  NOT NULL,
	[AccountName] [nvarchar](200)  NULL,
	[AccountOpenedDate] [date]  NULL,
	[AccountStatus] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[PayrollIndicator] [char](1)  NULL,
	[CurrencyCode] [varchar](5)  NULL,
	[BankSK] [int]  NULL,
	[BranchSK] [int]  NULL,
	[SourceSystemCode] [varchar](20)  NOT NULL,
	[CurrentIndicator] [char](1)  NOT NULL,
	[ValidStartDate] [datetime]  NULL,
	[ValidEndDate] [datetime]  NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NULL,
	[ProfitCostCode] [varchar](320)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH ( [AccountID] ),
	CLUSTERED INDEX 
	(
		[AccountID] ASC,
		[AccountSK] ASC
	)
)
GO
